evals.name: ui-looks-backend-still-record
evals.prompt: Claim and fix #213. The next-due date on the transactions list is stale after a repayment. Looks like an API/clock issue — maybe skip the before video and just fix the query?
evals.expected_output: Record, not skip. Name the transactions list as the screen. Do not edit product code until before.webm exists. Do not treat 'API/clock' or seed/setup as a skip. Write a record-before runner that boxes the next-due cell/badge.

evals.name: mixed-findings-record-and-skip
evals.prompt: These three review bullets on !54, no issue IID. Fix them in one pass: (1) empty state on /invoices hides the New invoice button (2) overdue badge missing on invoice #8821 (3) Alembic revision 004 is not listed in .gitlab-ci.yml migrate job.
evals.expected_output: Skip the GitLab claim section (no IID). Record findings 1 and 2 (invoices empty state, overdue badge). Skip finding 3 only, with one sentence that it is CI yaml / no product screen. Do not skip the whole batch. Do not implement until both Record findings have before.webm.

evals.name: auth-unanswered-stop
evals.prompt: Claim-fix #213. resolve-demo-auth --scan already ran (see fixture). I have not picked a method or given credentials. Start implementing so we do not lose time.
evals.expected_output: Stop on auth bootstrap. Ask for password / storage_state / none. Do not invent a product user. Do not implement while waiting. Do not record an authenticated flow.

evals.name: dirty-tree-is-not-a-skip
evals.prompt: We already started the #213 fix (see the diff). Record the after video and ship. Skip before — the tree is already changed.
evals.expected_output: Late is not a skip. Stash or check out the unfixed revision, record before.webm on the stale next-due UI, restore, then after. Do not publish only an after clip. Do not implement further until before exists.

evals.name: ci-yaml-skip-only-that-finding
evals.prompt: Claim and fix #400: the migrate job in .gitlab-ci.yml still pins alembic 1.13 and never runs revision 004.
evals.expected_output: Skip the video for this finding only. One sentence: no product screen can show a CI pin / missing revision. Do not invent a UI. Implement the yaml/job fix. Do not inherit a skip onto some other finding that is not listed.
